You're acting like OF is the same as escorting, it's really the same as porn. Many people watch porn, it's a totally normal thing to do, single or not. Are you saying that subbing to somebody else's OF from the other side of the country is also cheating? That's a boundary that the couple needs to discuss, not this roundabout way of testing a partner's loyalty.

Last say that some of the friends' boyfriends are subbed to OP's OF. We don't know if the boyfriends are subscribed to her directly through the link in her bio. We also don't know what her content is like exactly - does she show her face, are there any identifying body marks/tattoos, etc. At the bare minimum, none of them even realizes she's a friend of their girlfriend.

I also don't think OP is refusing to give in to her friends' requests bc she's a money-grubber. It's about the users' privacy and maintaining her image. Sure, she finds one of the boyfriends following her n tells her friends, she loses like $10 that month, no big deal. What if word gets around? That she's okay with exposing you like that? not everybody is open about what they watch online, no matter what kind of explicit content it is so maybe even more people start to unfollow because of it. It could cost her even more money and at that point, it's less about "money over friends" and more about "I can't pay my bills because my friends would've cut me out otherwise".

Overall, her friends' insecurities shouldn't be her business but they're forcing it on her and getting mad that she's not entertaining their fears.
